title: Add a Grammar Guide section or part
description: Stages a new Grammar Guide item in a Draft: a title, the part or section it goes under, where it goes, and optionally its body as FieldWorks Markdown in the ADR 0005 template. It takes the next permanent GDR-n number. A project with no Grammar Guide list gets the list too. Nothing reaches the FieldWorks project until a person applies the Draft. On a new project the order is guide add, apply, baseline capture, then guide check: the Guide reads see only the Baseline. Available in Advanced AI mode.
